Incite the Hunt: Whenever this operative incapacitates an enemy
operative from more than 2" away, before that enemy operative
is removed from the killzone, you can increase the GORE TANK
of one friendly GOREMONGER operative within 8" of that
enemy operative.

cards.text:
洒血狂杀戮小队
原型：侦查、搜索与摧毁
特工
↘ 1 名洒血狂鲜血使者特工
↘ 7 名洒血狂特工，从以下列表进行选择:
• 新进者
• 猎血者
• 穿刺者
• 鼓动者
• 猎颅者
• 追猎者
除了新进者特工以外，上述的每一名特工只能被
纳入您的杀戮小队一次。
cards.text_en:
GOREMONGERS KILL TEAM
ARCHETYPES: RECON, SEEK & DESTROY
OPERATIVES
↘ 1 GOREMONGER BLOOD HERALD operative
↘ 7 GOREMONGER operatives selected from the
following list:
• ASPIRANT
• BLOODTAKER
• IMPALER
• INCITER
• SKULLCLAIMER
• STALKER
Other than ASPIRANT operatives, your kill team
can only include each operative on this list once.

cards.text:
洒血狂
阵营规则
恐虐符文
洒血狂通过将恐虐符文刻入血肉，获得炼狱般
的远程攻击抗性。
每一名己方洒血狂特工在每次射击行动中不会
失去超过 8 点耐伤。
cards.text_en:
GOREMONGER
FACTION RULE
RUNES OF KHORNE
Khornate runes carved into the flesh of Goremongers
give them an infernal resistance to ranged attacks.
Each friendly GOREMONGER operative cannot
lose more than 8 wounds per Shoot action.

cards.text:
洒血狂
阵营规则
血污储罐
洒血狂的储罐中装着由兴奋剂，重组蛋白以
及炼金燃料组成的混剂。这种复合药剂能为
持有者供给能量，但需要持续不断的血液以
及其他材料供给，以便炼狱炼金术能够发挥最
大效力。
每一名己方洒血狂特工都有一个血污储罐，它
们有三种状态：满载，半载和空载。血污储罐在
战斗开始时为半载状态。当血污储罐内容增加
时，便会上升一级；每当其减少时，便会下降一
级，血污储罐在已经满载时无法增加内容，在已
经空载时无法减少内容（见下图）。
请继续阅读背面规则
cards.text_en:
GOREMONGER
FACTION RULE
GORE TANKS
Goremongers’ tanks contain a concoction of stimms,
recombinant proteins and alchemical fuel. This cocktail
energises the carrier, but the tanks require a constant
supply of blood and gore for the infernal alchemy to
function at peak efficiency.
Each friendly GOREMONGER operative has a
GORE TANK that has three levels: full, half and
empty. They start the battle at half. Whenever
a GORE TANK increases, it goes up one level;
whenever it decreases, it goes down one level.
A GORE TANK cannot increase when it’s already
full, or decrease when it’s already empty (see
diagram on other side).
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
洒血狂
阵营规则
猩红活剂
洒血狂储罐中含有血液的混剂名为猩红活剂。
借助这种液体，他们能够做出各种远超大多数
人类能力范围的血腥暴行。通过这些供给，他
们得以效仿放血者并对恐虐表现自己的崇拜。
每个猩红活剂规则都会描述其使用时机，并且在
使用时必须使特工的血污储罐内容减少。在每次
激活或反应中您不能使用同一个猩红活剂规则超
过一次，并且不能在每次激活或反应中使用猩红
活剂规则超过两次。此外，您不能在同一次激活
中同时使用癫狂和狂怒。
猩红活剂的详细规则请见其他卡片
cards.text_en:
GOREMONGER
FACTION RULE
SANGUAVITAE
The blood-infused concoction within the Goremongers’
tanks is known as sanguavitae. Empowered by this fluid,
they can undertake gore-drenched deeds far beyond the
capabilities of most Humans. Through these acts they
emulate Bloodletters and venerate Khorne.
Each SANGUAVITAE rule specifies when it can
be used, and you must decrease the operative’s
GORE TANK to do so. You cannot use the same
SANGUAVITAE rule more than once per activation
or counteraction, and you cannot use more
than two SANGUAVITAE rules per activation or
counteraction. You cannot use Mania and Fury
during the same activation.
SANGUAVITAE RULES ARE PRESENTED ON
THEIR OWN CARDS

时机：当一名己方洒血狂特工执行冲锋或转
移行动。
效果：直到那次行动结束前，为那名特工的移
动属性增加 1"。
cards.text_en:
GOREMONGER
FACTION RULE
SANGUAVITAE
Surge
WHEN: When a friendly GOREMONGER
operative performs the Charge or
Reposition action.
EFFECT: Until the end of that action, add 1" to
that operative’s Move stat.

忿怒

动。
效果：直到那次行动结束前，为那名特工近战
武器的攻击属性增加 1 点。
cards.text_en:
GOREMONGER
FACTION RULE
SANGUAVITAE
Rage
WHEN: When a friendly GOREMONGER
operative performs the Fight action.
EFFECT: Until the end of that action, add 1
to the Atk stat of that operative’s
melee weapons.

cards.text:
洒血狂
战略计谋
强化残暴
在猩红活剂赋予的力量下，洒血狂的战斗力比
起任何未经强化的人类都更为凶猛和干练。
每当一名己方洒血狂特工的血污储罐处于：
• 半载，其近战武器获得“平衡”武器规则。
• 满载，其近战武器获得“毫不留情”武器规
则。
cards.text_en:
GOREMONGER
STRATEGY PLOY
ENHANCED VIOLENCE
When powered by sanguavitae, Goremongers
fight with far greater ferocity and skill than any
unaugmented Human.
Whenever a friendly GOREMONGER operative’s
GORE TANK is:
• Half, its melee weapons have the Balanced
weapon rule.
• Full, its melee weapons have the Relentless
weapon rule.

cards.text:
洒血狂
战略计谋
耐力增强
猩红活剂的注入能使目标的身心甚至灵魂都极
为坚韧。
当一名己方洒血狂特工受到一名特工射击时，
其血污储罐处于：
• 半载，您可以重掷一枚己方防御骰子。
• 满载，您可以重掷任意己方防御骰子。
cards.text_en:
GOREMONGER
STRATEGY PLOY
AUGMENTED ENDURANCE
An infusion of sanguavitae serves to harden the
subject’s mind, body and soul, rendering them
supremely resilient.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
GOREMONGER operative, if that friendly
operative’s GORE TANK is:
• Half, you can re-roll one of your defence dice.
• Full, you can re-roll any of your defence dice.

cards.text:
洒血狂
战略计谋
血腥坚毅
屠杀愿景让洒血狂陷入了狂怒中。在这种怒火
下，他们甚至不会受到极为严重伤害的影响。
当一名己方洒血狂特工进行近战或反击时，您
的对手在那个流程中第一次使用出击时，将其
伤害减半（向上取整，最低为 2）。
cards.text_en:
GOREMONGER
STRATEGY PLOY
GORY TENACITY
The prospect of carnage drives Goremongers into
a maniacal fury. Enraged thus, they are capable of
shrugging off terrible wounds.
Whenever a friendly GOREMONGER operative is
fighting or retaliating, the first time your opponent
strikes it during that sequence, halve the damage
inflicted (rounding up and to a minimum of 2).

cards.text:
洒血狂
战略计谋
狩猎鲜血
随着鲜血飞溅，铜臭味充斥于空气中，导致洒
血狂陷入狂热饥渴中。
选择一名己方洒血狂特工，若其拥有隐匿命
令，则将其转变为交战。随后它可以立即执行
一次无消耗的冲锋行动，但在那次行动中移动
不能超过 3"。
cards.text_en:
GOREMONGER
STRATEGY PLOY
HUNT FOR BLOOD
As blood is spilled, its copper scent fills the air, driving
the Goremongers into a thirsting frenzy.
Select one friendly GOREMONGER operative. If
it has a Conceal order, change it to Engage. Then
it can immediately perform a free Charge action,
but cannot move more than 3" during that action.

cards.text:
洒血狂
交战计谋
无边好斗
洒血狂一旦接近敌人，便会展现出他崇敬放血
者的狂野怒火和武艺进行战斗。
在一名己方洒血狂特工在执行过冲锋行动的激
活中进行近战的掷攻击骰子步骤结束时使用此交
战计谋。直到那个流程结束前，那名特工的近战
武器获得“严重”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
GOREMONGER
FIREFIGHT PLOY
UNBRIDLED AGGRESSION
When they close with the enemy, Goremongers fight
with all the savage fury and martial prowess of the
Bloodletters they so idolise.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly
GOREMONGER operative is fighting during
an activation in which it performed the Charge
action, at the end of the Roll Attack Dice step.
Until the end of that sequence, that operative’s
melee weapons have the Severe weapon rule.

cards.text:
洒血狂
交战计谋
渴望血肉
洒血狂就如同飞蛾扑火般受暴力吸引，难以克
制自己对泼洒脏器的渴望。
在将要使用一名己方洒血狂特工进行反应时使
用此交战计谋。您可以为此选择拥有隐匿命令的
一名己方洒血狂特工，但在反应前，您必须将
其命令改为交战，且在那次反应中不能执行任何
除了冲锋，近战或射击以外的行动。
cards.text_en:
GOREMONGER
FIREFIGHT PLOY
GORETHIRST
Goremongers are drawn to violence like insects
to blazing lumen, unable to control their thirst to
spill viscera.
Use this firefight ploy when you would counteract.
You can do so with one friendly GOREMONGER
operative that has a Conceal order, but before it
counteracts, you must change its order to Engage
and it cannot perform any actions other than
Charge, Shoot or Fight during that counteraction.

cards.text:
洒血狂
交战计谋
毁灭性消散
在敌人鲜血的力量加持下，身负重伤的洒血狂
会在倒下前疯狂复仇。
当一名己方洒血狂特工被残废时，在将其移出
杀戮区前使用此交战计谋。位于那名己方特工控
制范围内的一名敌方特工将受到对应于其血污储
罐状态的伤害：
• 当其血污储罐状态为空载时，受到 D3 点伤
害。
• 当其血污储罐状态为半载时，受到 D3+1 点
伤害。
• 当其血污储罐状态为满载时，受到 D3+2 点
伤害。
cards.text_en:
GOREMONGER
FIREFIGHT PLOY
DESTRUCTIVE DEMISE
Empowered by the blood of their foes, mortally wounded
Goremongers expend the last of their might in a
vengeful frenzy.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly
GOREMONGER operative is incapacitated,
before it’s removed from the killzone. Inflict
damage determined by that friendly operative’s
GORE TANK on one enemy operative within that
friendly operative’s control range. Inflict:
• D3 if empty.
• D3+1 if half.
• D3+2 if full.

cards.text:
洒血狂
交战计谋
撕裂血肉
洒血狂甚至会用自己的猩红液体补充其血罐。
当然，这是只有在绝望疯狂中才会使用的最
后手段。
在血污储罐状态为空载的一名己方洒血狂特工
进行激活或反应时使用此交战计谋。增加那名特
工的血污储罐内容，并在那次激活或反击结束时
减少其血污储罐内容（您不能通过这次减少使用
猩红活剂规则）；若您无法再减少其血污储罐内
容，它便受到 D3 点伤害。
cards.text_en:
GOREMONGER
FIREFIGHT PLOY
LACERATE FLESH
Goremongers may resort to topping up their blood tanks
with their own crimson fluid. Doing so is a last resort,
undertaken only in a desperate frenzy.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly
GOREMONGER operative with an empty GORE
TANK is activated or counteracts. Increase
that operative’s GORE TANK. At the end of that
activation/counteraction, decrease its GORE
TANK (you cannot use this decrease to use a
SANGUAVITAE rule); if you cannot decrease its
GORE TANK, inflict D3 damage on it.

cards.text:
洒血狂
阵营装备
血污图腾
血污以及剥制的头骨划出了洒血狂的地盘。
在战斗前，您可以将一枚己方血污图腾标识放置
在完全位于己方领地内且位于其他标识（己方
血腥尸体标识除外）的 2" 外。每当一名敌方特
工在己方血污图腾 3" 内进行射击，近战或反击
时，您的对手便无法为它重掷攻击骰子。
cards.text_en:
GOREMONGER
FACTION EQUIPMENT
GORY TOTEM
Gore and peeled skulls mark the limits of the
Goremongers’ territory.
Before the battle, you can set up one of your Gory
Totem markers wholly within your territory and
more than 2" from other markers (excluding your
Bloody Cadaver marker). Whenever an enemy
operative within 3" of your Gory Totem marker is
shooting, fighting or retaliating, your opponent
cannot re-roll their attack dice.

cards.text:
洒血狂
阵营装备
血腥尸体
洒血狂常常会藏起尸体，以便之后食用和补
充养料。
在战斗前，您可以将一枚己方血腥尸体标识放置
在完全位于己方领地内且位于其他标识（己方血
污图腾标识除外）的 2" 外。己方洒血狂特工可
以对那个标识执行拾取标识行动。在每个战略阶
段的就绪步骤中，控制那个标识的己方洒血狂
特工若不位于敌方特工的控制范围内，便可以增
加其血污储罐内容。
cards.text_en:
GOREMONGER
FACTION EQUIPMENT
BLOODY CADAVER
Goremongers will often stash corpses for later
consumption and refuelling.
Before the battle, you can set up one of your
Bloody Cadaver markers wholly within your
territory and more than 2" from other markers
(excluding your Gory Totem marker). Friendly
GOREMONGER operatives can perform the Pick
Up Marker action on that marker. In the Ready
step of each Strategy phase, you can increase
the GORE TANK of one friendly GOREMONGER
operative that controls that marker, unless that
friendly operative is within control range of an
enemy operative.

cards.text:
洒血狂
阵营装备
混沌印记
刻入肉体，印上盔甲的毁灭之力符文能为持有
者供上恶毒的力量。
每个转折点限一次，当一名特工对一名己方洒血
狂特工进行射击时，您便可以使用本规则。若
此，在那次流程结束前将“穿刺”武器规则的 X
值降低 1 点（如果有）。请注意，这意味着穿刺
1 将被忽视。
cards.text_en:
GOREMONGER
FACTION EQUIPMENT
CHAOS SIGIL
The runes of the Ruinous Powers are carved into flesh
and borne upon armour and clothing, providing their
bearers with malefic might.
Once per turning point, when an operative is
shooting a friendly GOREMONGER operative,
at the start of the Roll Defence Dice step, you
can use this rule. If you do, worsen the x of the
Piercing weapon rule by 1 (if any) until the end
of that sequence. Note that Piercing 1 would
therefore be ignored.

cards.text:
洒血狂
阵营装备
腕缚链条
通过使用一定长度的链条拴住武器，洒血狂们
能够将武器扔向敌人。
每个转折点限一次，当一名己方洒血狂特工在
执行射击行动中选择远程武器时，您便可以使用
本规则。若此，则直到那次行动结束前，下列近
战武器被视为具有“范围 2"”武器规则的远程武
器：链锯刃，链锯长刀，链锯巨斧（忽视其“残
暴”武器规则）以及撕裂镐。若那个近战武器因
为强化残暴战略计谋的效果而拥有“平衡”和
“毫不留情”武器规则，则它在作为一个远程武
器时也拥有那些武器规则。
cards.text_en:
GOREMONGER
FACTION EQUIPMENT
WRIST CHAINS
The Goremongers secure their weapons with lengths of
chain, enabling them to be hurled towards an opponent.
Once per turning point, when a friendly
GOREMONGER operative performs the Shoot
action and you’re selecting a ranged weapon, you
can use this rule. If you do, until the end of that
action, the following melee weapons are treated
as ranged weapons with the Range 2" weapon
rule: chainblade, chainglaive, great chainaxe
(ignore its Brutal weapon rule), pickrippers. If that
melee weapon has the Balanced or Relentless
weapon rules as a result of the Enhanced
Violence strategy ploy, it has those weapon rules
while it is a ranged weapon.
